sloka: विवर्त्य नयने क्रूरे मुष्टिमुद्यम्य दक्षिणम् ।मैथिलीं हन्तुमारब्धः स्त्रीभिर्हा हा कृतं तदा ।। ५.५८.७४ ।।।।
transliteration: vivartya nayane krūre muṣṭimudyamya dakṣiṇam ।maithilīṁ hantumārabdhaḥ strībhirhā hā kṛtaṁ tadā ।। 5.58.74 ।।।।

translations.english: "Then the wicked Ravana raised his eyebrows and his right fist to strike at Sita and even the shedemon there raised their voice saying, ' alas, alas '
